title: Biological Evaluation of a Novel Compound with Predicted EZH2 and EED Binding Against Human Malignant Melanoma Cells.
authors: Gorbunov, Sergei; Kyriakou, Sotiris; Anestopoulos, Ioannis; Khoso, Shahzaib; Manfredi, Marcello; Franco, Rodrigo; Pappa, Aglaia; Panayiotidis, Mihalis I
one_liner_zh: 该文评估新型化合物SG-8对黑色素瘤细胞的生物活性，涉及EZH2/EED结合预测，但核心是药物细胞实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法仅含分子对接且非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Enhancer of Zeste Homolog 2 (EZH2), the catalytic subunit of Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2), mediates histone H3 lysine 27 trimethylation (H3K27me3), an epigenetic modification associated with transcriptional repression. EZH2 inhibitors (EZH2is) gained attention after the first-in-class drug Tazemetostat received FDA approval for treating epithelioid sarcoma. Preclinical studies suggest that EZH2is could be effective against melanoma, but their general inability to cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB), among others, limits the treatment of secondary brain metastases. Based on these limitations, we designed SG-8, a novel compound derived from TDI-6118 (a known brain-penetrant EZH2i). In silico docking predicted that SG-8 may exhibit high affinity for EZH2 as well as for another PRC2 subunit, Embryonic Ectoderm Development (EED). In addition, in vitro PAMPA assays suggested passive BBB permeability of SG-8. In cell-based assays, SG-8 and the structurally related EZH2i PF-06726304 displayed lower cytotoxicity than Tazemetostat in both primary (A375) and metastatic (Colo-679) human melanoma cells. Western blot analysis showed that SG-8 and PF-06726304 markedly reduced EED protein levels and, to a lesser extent, EZH2 levels, without affecting total H3K27me3, consistent with preserved canonical PRC2 activity. Instead, treatment with both compounds-most prominently SG-8-was associated with reduced phosphorylation levels of EZH2 (Ser21) and its upstream regulator Akt (Ser473), suggesting that modulation of the Akt-EZH2 signaling axis may at least partially contribute to their anti-melanoma activity.
abstract_zh: Zeste同源增强子2（EZH2）是Polycomb抑制复合物2（PRC2）的催化亚基，介导组蛋白H3第27位赖氨酸三甲基化（H3K27me3），这是一种与转录抑制相关的表观遗传修饰。EZH2抑制剂（EZH2is）在首创新药Tazemetostat获得FDA批准用于治疗上皮样肉瘤后受到关注。临床前研究表明，EZH2is可能对黑色素瘤有效，但其普遍无法穿越血脑屏障（BBB）等因素限制了继发性脑转移的治疗。基于这些局限性，我们设计了SG-8，一种源自TDI-6118（一种已知的脑渗透性EZH2i）的新型化合物。计算机模拟对接预测SG-8可能对EZH2以及PRC2的另一亚基胚胎外胚层发育蛋白（EED）具有高亲和力。此外，体外PAMPA实验提示SG-8具有被动BBB渗透性。在细胞实验中，SG-8和结构相关的EZH2i PF-06726304在原代（A375）和转移性（Colo-679）人黑色素瘤细胞中均表现出比Tazemetostat更低的细胞毒性。Western blot分析显示，SG-8和PF-06726304显著降低EED蛋白水平，并在较小程度上降低EZH2水平，而不影响总H3K27me3，这与保留的经典PRC2活性一致。相反，两种化合物（尤其是SG-8）的处理与EZH2（Ser21）及其上游调控因子Akt（Ser473）磷酸化水平降低相关，提示Akt-EZH2信号轴的调节可能至少部分促成了其抗黑色素瘤活性。
